title: CUB permutation-aware sparse attention calibration screen
research_question: Can one keypoint-annotated image per class calibrate the permutation-symmetric attention channels of a strong K0 PrPool model without sacrificing its classification ability?

novelty_boundary.claimed: Sparse semantic keypoints are used to identify and calibrate already learned attention channels through a fold-local one-to-one assignment, while a frozen K0 teacher preserves classification and unannotated attention behavior.
not_claimed: first use of keypoints for attention supervision
first equivariant or consistent attention method
absolute first work without a completed citation-chain audit

data.sparse_budget: one randomly frozen keypoint-annotated fold-training image per class

arms.PRPOOL_K0: Nine-epoch architecture-matched teacher with no keypoint loss.
arms.WARMSTART_IDENTITY: K0 initialization followed by four sparse-keypoint epochs using the original fixed part-channel identity; no teacher preservation.
arms.PERMUTATION_ONLY: K0 initialization followed by four sparse-keypoint epochs using a fold-local Hungarian part-channel assignment; no teacher preservation.
arms.PASAC: Permutation-only calibration plus frozen-K0 logit distillation and attention preservation on unannotated images.

assignment.inputs: only selected fold-training images, their permitted keypoint maps, and frozen K0 attention maps
assignment.cost: mean negative log spatial attention mass inside each visible keypoint target mask

endpoints.primary: OOF balanced accuracy of PASAC versus WARMSTART_IDENTITY
endpoints.mechanism: OOF semantic attention hit rate, defined as matched-channel argmax falling inside the rendered 3x3 keypoint target
endpoints.safety: OOF balanced accuracy of PASAC versus PRPOOL_K0

go_no_go.accuracy_branch: PASAC improves balanced accuracy by at least 0.50 pp over WARMSTART_IDENTITY, improves attention hit rate by at least 3 pp, and is no worse than K0 by more than 0.25 pp.
go_no_go.localization_branch: PASAC is no worse than WARMSTART_IDENTITY by more than 0.25 pp in balanced accuracy, improves attention hit rate by at least 5 pp, and is no worse than K0 by more than 0.25 pp.
go_no_go.on_go: Run the same frozen protocol on episodes 2 and 3, then prepare an EI-conference-scale CUB plus CCT validation.
go_no_go.on_no_go: Stop keypoint-attention work and write the architecture-matched negative result; do not tune this screen.

data_controls.smoke_test: one fold, one teacher epoch, one student epoch per arm
